digest.component_or_area: reconciler apply and subprocess runtime environment
propositions: Write/apply and subprocess paths rebuild config or reuse broad parent environments instead of using S2 operation bindings and scoped runtimes
Jira Cloud scope has implicit DIG fallbacks in write path, live access-check probe, runtime default, and create-time default that can write under unintended scope or leak credentials

Child environment builder must distinguish trusted same-capability children (ambient inheritance), owning children (adapter overlay only), and unrelated siblings (excluding other adapters' secret names)

Every implicit DIG default in Jira write path, live access-check probe, and runtime constants must be eliminated so DIG is used only when explicitly configured; unset cases fail closed with typed error
Global os.environ must not be mutated across reconciler apply, Git push, ACLI delivery, and bridge orchestration operations, and no cross-operation credential observation is possible
